verdict.rationale: Shortwave is an email client, so tracking-pixel protection and data transparency are fair questions to ask. However, the evidence pack has no first-party documentation of blocking read pixels or other sender tracking, by default or otherwise. The only data-handling evidence is community commenters describing a privacy policy that covers collecting email contents and metadata and sharing data with vendors, and noting that all mail syncs to Shortwave's servers. That is not documented tracking protection.

support.subject: As a switcher, the client protects me from senders' tracking — blocking read pixels by default — and is transparent about what it does with my mail data
